newsitem.title: MOROCCO: PRESS DIGEST - Morocco economic weeklies - Feb 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Morocco economic weeklies - Feb 28.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Morocco's economic press. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- During a Euromoney forum attended by international experts, International Monetary Fund representative hinted that Morocco's economic pickup did not mean it had overcome all its weaknesses.
- GE Information Services, a unit of General Electric Co, has established a joint venture in electronic commerce services in Morocco expected to be operational in April.
- National League for the Protection of Consumers callS for creation of regional supply cooperatives. LA NOUVELLE TRIBUNE

- Banks plan to get more customers using Visa credit cards in the next months. Visa plans to increase number of users to 400,000 from 60,000 by the end of the current year through a promotional campaign and by converting cash dispenser cards into credit cards.
